title: SpikeyTotem
description: Balances the Totem of Undying by dealing small damage while held.
body:
This plugin is designed to make totems less op and offer more of a fair fight with people who have an accsessive amount of totems. It is designed to be used on servers which are more competative rather then servers that are less competative over all.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
